speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Ultrasound reveals a complex mass with leaf-like structures and stromal overgrowth; vascularity is present within the stromal component.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Phyllodes Tumor. The ultrasound findings of a complex mass with leaf-like structures and stromal overgrowth are pathognomonic for this diagnosis. I recommend immediate excision with wide margins and sending the specimen for histopathology to determine the specific subtype and grade.
